title: Give OLY-B-S1-02 a mechanism: study reuse/instance split test
summary: Add an athena-core integration test that checks, on the real repo, that reusable study logic sits in crates/athena-cap-study (free of instance names) and instance data stays in studies/<id>/ (data only, pinned, no code); record the test as the mechanism in docs/spec.toml with a measure ending `status: not shown`. Audience: Athena's spec-gap check and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New test file plus cargo test/clippy/fmt criterion.
Criteria run the named test command on real files.
Rule enforced by a test recorded in docs/spec.toml.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs (model: real-file checks, owner_problem, measure_label_problem using parse_spec/measure_problem/spec_gaps from crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs), crates/athena-core/src/run/pin.rs (studies/<id>/pin.json), crates/athena-cap-study/src/{lib,model,records,rules}.rs exist. The test adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord round trip are not touched.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (parse_spec, measure_problem, spec_gaps), crates/athena-core/tests/learnings_recorded.rs pattern, crates/athena-cap-study/src, studies/firstmate-work-handling/, docs/spec.toml; the new test reuses hestia functions.

Only one instance (firstmate-work-handling) is studied so far; Hermes and Athena are not. The test therefore checks the split on existing instances generically (iterating every studies/*/), so later instances are covered automatically.
Fresh context per instance and gap-fix-and-recheck cannot be shown by static file checks; the measure honestly ends `status: not shown` and names the test command, and the test docs state this limit.
The mechanism path is crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs; test command `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split`.
Consumers: none found for new files; no config files change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-S1-02 has mechanism naming crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs (not "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure that names `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split` and ends with `status: not shown`.

crates/athena-core/tests/study_instance_split.rs asserts on real files that every studies/<id>/ holds only data (json/md, no .rs) and has a pin.json, and that crates/athena-cap-study/src does not contain any studies/ instance id string.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split`: passes on the change; its negative-case unit tests (an instance dir with a .rs file, a capability source naming an instance, a missing pin, a measure lacking the label) each produce a problem, so the test fails without the mechanism.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split`: the test also confirms the real OLY-B-S1-02 requirement no longer appears in spec_gaps (mechanism and measure present, measure_problem is None).
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test pass on the final tree (Athena's recorded check on the same tree counts).
CHANGELOG.md gets a job entry; no other governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.

out_of_scope: Studying Hermes Agent or Athena itself
Changing the study capability's runtime behavior or prompts
